author: TED-Ed
description:
You accidentally end up in the top secret lab of an eccentric candy factory. Can you win Billy Bonka's game and get set free?

--

You’re on a tour of the eccentric Billy Bonka’s mysterious candy factory, when a wrong turn searching for the restroom lands you in the top secret candy laboratory. Enraged at your trespassing, Bonka explains that the consequences are simple: you must play his game. You lose, and he’ll throw you into his Chew-o-meter 3000. Can you outsmart Billy Bonka’s challenge? Edwin F. Meyer shows how.

Lesson by Edwin F. Meyer, directed by Igor Ćorić, Artrake Studio.
